attributes.name: Camel Race Finish Line
attributes.powers: When you encounter this card, if the Camel Race location deck contains more than 5 cards, the Camel Race Finish Line is evaded, and you may explore again. Otherwise, for each character and the Cultist Charioteers, roll 1d8+1d6 and add the number of cards in the respective trophy stack. Add this card to a trophy stack associated with one of the highest rolls. Then put the loot Muminofrah's Favor into one of the stack with the highest number of cards.
